name: 'Point A' Manager
author: Agent15
summary: Library that remembers the tile each piece moved from, for other mods to build on.
description: Not much to see on its own - install it because another mod asked for it. The game only remembers where a piece landed; this library tracks where it came from (for both player and enemy moves) and offers a helper to compute the distance and direction of the last move. Powers gambits like Recursion's and Sniper's.
